faqs.a: Use the RSVP page. You can tell us your dietary requirements and anything else we should know.

faqs.q: How do I reply for my partner or family?
faqs.a: Each person replies separately. After sending your own reply, use "RSVP for another guest" at the bottom of the RSVP page and enter their name.
Send the RSVP form again. Your latest reply replaces the earlier one.

faqs.q: Can I bring a plus one or children?
faqs.a: Due to venue capacity only named guests are invited.
